items.summary: После успешной гуманитарной операции в Олешках Владимир Зеленский предложил провести аналогичную эвакуацию жителей еще 15 оккупированных населенных пунктов. В Херсонской области в список вошли Раденск, Костогрызово, Голая Пристань, Старая Збурьевка, Новая Збурьевка, Гладковка, Большие Копани, Кардашинка и Большая Кардашинка. items.title: Russian drone attacks car in Kharkiv Oblast, killing two
items.summary: A Russian drone struck a civilian car in Kharkiv Oblast's Zolochiv hromada on 25 November, killing two people, likely a local couple, Syniehubov said.

items.title: Gazprom reports record gas withdrawals in Germany, France due to cold weather
items.summary: According to the Russian gas holding, storage levels in Germany continue to decline and now stand at 55%

items.title: Budanov: First phase of major prisoner exchange could take place in late Nov or early Dec
items.summary: A large-scale exchange of prisoners of war will take place in several stages, the first of which is expected in late November or early December, Head of the President's Office of Ukraine Kyrylo Budanov said.

items.title: European Parliament approves 2027 EU budget, allocating €650 mln to service Ukraine Loan
items.summary: On Wednesday, Members of the European Parliament (MEPs) gave final approval to the European Union's annual budget for 2027.

items.title: Ukraine awaits date from USA for new four-party meeting involving Europe – Zelenskyy
items.summary: During a meeting with Estonian Foreign Minister Margus Tsahkna, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy discussed the negotiation process and future security guarantees, stating that Kyiv is currently awaiting a date from the American side for a new four-party meeting that would include European participation.

items.title: Moldova launches national preparedness campaign after drone incursions
items.summary: Moldova is urging its citizens to prepare for emergencies as the war in neighbouring Ukraine brings new risks across its border. The “Moldova Ready” campaign, launched in Chisinau, includes a display of the remains of a drone carrying 52kg of explosives after it crashed in the country last month. FRANCE 24's Daniel Whittington reports.

items.title: NATO activity near Russia’s borders raises risk of clash between nuclear powers — diplomat
items.summary: Yulia Zhdanova underscored that Russia is ready to use "all means of self-defense at its disposal" to protect its sovereignty and territorial integrity

items.title: One person killed, 10 injured in Russian airstrike on Sloviansk – National Police
items.summary: At least one person was killed and 10 others were injured when Russian forces struck the city of Sloviansk in Donetsk region with an FAB-500 aerial bomb equipped with a UMPK (unified planning and correction module) on Wednesday, the National Police of Ukraine reported.

items.title: Ukraine and Hungary to hold first meeting of minority rights commission in early 2027
items.summary: Ukraine and Hungary will co-chair a commission on national minority rights, with its first meeting planned for early 2027, Hungarian PM Anita Orbán has said.

items.title: Dnipro sets up additional emergency assistance points amid power supply problems
items.summary: Emergency responders have set up additional assistance points for residents of Dnipro amid the difficult electricity supply situation in the city.

items.title: Бастрыкин поручил проводить рейды по местам массового пребывания молодежи с участием МВД, ФСБ и Росгвардии
items.summary: Глава СК Александр Бастрыкин поручил организовать совместные рейды силовиков по местам массового пребывания молодежи. Об этом ведомство сообщило по итогам совещания 24 ноября, посвященного групповой преступности среди подростков, пишет «Интерфакс». 🔵 Детали. items.title: English textbook in Russia swaps American jeans, chips, and Coca-Cola for valenki, kholodets, and kvass
items.summary: The authors of the Starlight English-language textbook for eighth grade replaced a text about American food and clothing with one about Russian dishes and everyday items, the independent Russian news outlet Verstka reported.

items.title: Poland plans no-fly zone near Ukraine border, asks NATO to intercept Russian missiles over Ukraine
items.summary: The proposals come amid growing concerns over Russian aerial incursions into NATO territory, following a series of incidents involving Russian missiles and drones entering Polish airspace during attacks on Ukraine on Nov. 23 and 24.

items.title: Himera raises $5 million to expand military communications business
items.summary: "This investment allows us to advance technologies that help Ukrainian defenders carry out their missions more effectively," said Misha Rudominski, Himera's co-founder and CEO.
